title: Selected Topics in Information Processing; Modern Computational Speech and Audition
description:
Must be in the Computer Science Master's or Doctoral program; or permission of the instructor.

Perception of audio events, music and speech plays a fundamental role inhuman interaction with the world. Auditory perception is equally vital for an animal's life and survival. This course will first review fundamental problems in computational audition and speech processing. It will then focus on large audio language models and associated problems.
